toni: alert from admission: cosign verify failing for a canary image; pods stuck Pending.

devon: paste cosign error?

toni: `Error: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = permission denied for KMS signer`

audit-bot: AuditEvent: IAMPolicyChange actor=ops-sync@redwood time=2026-05-02T01:03:12Z change=removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner from serviceAccount:cosign@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com

devon: ops-sync drift again. rebind with gcloud: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/container/cryptoKeys/signer --member="serviceAccount:cosign@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"`

toni: doing it now, will re-run attest job for affected digest list.

audit-bot: ActionLog: iam_binding_added actor=toni@redwood target=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/container/cryptoKeys/signer time=2026-05-02T02:12:05Z

images-team: verification succeeded for 3/4 digests; one artifact was signed with a destroyed key version -> pipeline rebuild & sign queued.

sre-oncall: canary pinned at 5%, monitoring. no customer impact.

devon: follow-ups: add ops-sync allowlist for cosign SA, add IAM-drift alerting, and CI preflight to assert attestation upload + KMS binding post-rotation. PRs: infra/PR#980, ci/PR#271.

toni: updated runbook note: do not relax admission gates; restore IAM + regen attests or rebuild + re-sign. tagging owners and closing when rebuild completes. :white_check_mark:
